title: AI Receptionist Lead Intelligence input
description: Discover and rank recent receptionist/CSR/dispatcher hiring signals for electrical and other home-service businesses.

niches.title: Target niches
niches.description: Primary industries to identify. Keep 'electrical' for the electrician-first strategy.

states.title: US states
states.description: Leave empty to search all 50 states plus DC.

freshnessDays.title: Maximum posting age
freshnessDays.description: Ignore job postings older than this number of days.

minimumScore.title: Minimum final score
minimumScore.description: Only output leads whose final intent score meets or exceeds this value.

enrichThreshold.title: Company enrichment threshold
enrichThreshold.description: Resolve the official company website and contact details for leads at or above this score.

maxLeads.title: Maximum output leads
maxLeads.description: Maximum number of ranked leads to save in the output dataset.

maxSerpRequests.title: Maximum Google SERP requests
maxSerpRequests.description: Hard limit on Google search requests used for discovery and enrichment.

resultsPerQueryPages.title: SERP pages per query
resultsPerQueryPages.description: Number of Google result pages to request for each discovery query.

companyEnrichment.title: Enrich hot companies
companyEnrichment.description: When enabled, visit official company websites to collect public contact details for strong leads.

trackHistory.title: Track repeat hiring across runs
trackHistory.description: When enabled, store qualified companies across runs and boost repeated hiring signals.

historyStoreName.title: Persistent history store
historyStoreName.description: Name of the Apify key-value store used for cross-run lead history.

seedUrls.title: Optional seed job URLs
seedUrls.description: Useful for testing known job postings without discovery.
